# CBT/DBT Associates

> NYC-based therapy practice specializing in evidence-based CBT and DBT treatment for anxiety, depression, trauma, and personality disorders.

CBT/DBT Associates is a mental health practice in New York City offering specialized cognitive behavioral therapy and dialectical behavior therapy services. The practice treats a wide range of mental health conditions with locations in New York and Florida, led by experienced clinicians trained in evidence-based therapeutic approaches.

## Key Topics

- Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT)
- Dialectical Behavior Therapy (DBT)
- Emotion Regulation
- Anxiety Disorders
- Depression Treatment
- PTSD and Trauma Therapy
- Exposure Therapy
- Obsessive-Compulsive Disorder (OCD)
- Borderline Personality Disorder (BPD)
- Panic Disorder
- Social Anxiety
- Stress Management
- Mindfulness
- New York City
- Mental Health Services

- [Generalized Anxiety Disorder Treatment | CBT/DBT Associates](https://www.cbtdbtassociates.com/what-we-treat/generalized-anxiety-disorder): Generalized anxiety disorder treatment with worry management

## Trauma, Personality & Behavioral Disorders

- [Post-Traumatic Stress Disorder | CBT/DBT Associates](https://www.cbtdbtassociates.com/what-we-treat/post-traumatic-stress-disorder-ptsd): PTSD treatment using CBT and DBT trauma therapy approaches
- [Trauma Treatment In New York and Florida - CBT/DBT Associates](https://www.cbtdbtassociates.com/what-we-treat/trauma): Trauma and PTSD treatment in New York and Florida locations
- [Borderline Personality Disorder (BPD) | CBT/DBT Associates](https://www.cbtdbtassociates.com/what-we-treat/borderline-personality-disorder-bpd): BPD treatment with emotion regulation focus via concierge therapy
- [Obsessive Compulsive Disorder (OCD) | CBT/DBT Associates](https://www.cbtdbtassociates.com/what-we-treat/obsessive-compulsive-disorder-ocd): OCD treatment using behavioral CBT and DBT approaches
- [Attention-Deficit Hyperactivity Disorder (ADHD) | CBT/DBT Associates](https://www.cbtdbtassociates.com/what-we-treat/attention-deficit-hyperactivity-disorder-adhd): ADHD treatment and assessment using CBT and DBT approaches
